name: Technitium DNS Server
description: Technitium DNS Server is an authoritative and recursive DNS server for privacy, security, local network domain resolution, DNS-over-TLS/HTTPS/QUIC, and network-wide ad blocking.
short_desc: Authoritative & recursive DNS server with ad blocking and DoH/DoT/DoQ support
author: Technitium Software

form_fields.label: DNS Server Domain Name (FQDN)
form_fields.hint: The primary fully qualified domain name used by this DNS Server to identify itself.

form_fields.label: Admin Web Console Password
form_fields.hint: The DNS web console admin user password (read on first startup).

form_fields.label: Admin Password File Path
form_fields.hint: Path to a file containing the plain text admin password.

form_fields.label: Prefer IPv6 for Upstream Queries
form_fields.hint: DNS Server will use IPv6 for querying whenever possible.

form_fields.label: Web Console Local IP Addresses
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of IP addresses for web console to listen on (only with host mode).

form_fields.label: Web Console HTTP Port
form_fields.hint: Internal TCP port number for the DNS web console over HTTP.

form_fields.label: Web Console HTTPS Port
form_fields.hint: Internal TCP port number for the DNS web console over HTTPS.

form_fields.label: Enable HTTPS for Web Console
form_fields.hint: Enables HTTPS for the DNS web console.

form_fields.label: Use Self-Signed Certificate for HTTPS
form_fields.hint: Enables self-signed TLS certificate for the web console.

form_fields.label: TLS Certificate File Path (.pfx)
form_fields.hint: Path to custom TLS certificate for the web console (e.g. /etc/dns/tls/cert.pfx).

form_fields.label: TLS Certificate Password
form_fields.hint: Password for the custom TLS certificate.

form_fields.label: Redirect HTTP to HTTPS
form_fields.hint: Enables HTTP to HTTPS redirection for the DNS web console.

form_fields.label: Allowed Reverse Proxy IP Addresses
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of IP addresses or network CIDRs allowed to act as reverse proxy. Prefix with ! to deny.

form_fields.label: Enable DNS-over-HTTP (Port 80/8053)
form_fields.hint: Enables DNS-over-HTTP protocol for use behind TLS terminating reverse proxy.

form_fields.label: DNS Recursion Policy
form_fields.hint: Control which clients can use recursive queries.

form_fields.label: Recursion Network ACL
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of IP/CIDR addresses (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24, !192.168.1.10). Valid when recursion is UseSpecifiedNetworkACL.

form_fields.label: Recursion Denied Networks (Legacy)
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of networks to deny recursion.

form_fields.label: Recursion Allowed Networks (Legacy)
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of networks to allow recursion.

form_fields.label: Enable Ad & Domain Blocking
form_fields.hint: Sets the DNS server to block domain names using Blocked Zone and Block List Zone.

form_fields.label: Allow TXT Blocking Report
form_fields.hint: Respond with TXT records containing a blocked domain report for TXT type queries.

form_fields.label: Block List URLs
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of block list URLs to automatically download and update.

form_fields.label: Upstream DNS Forwarders
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of forwarder IP addresses (e.g. 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8, 9.9.9.9).

form_fields.label: Upstream Forwarder Protocol
form_fields.hint: Protocol used to query upstream forwarders.

form_fields.label: Log Using Local Time
form_fields.hint: Use local timezone for logging instead of UTC.

form_fields.label: Log Folder Path
form_fields.hint: Folder path on server where logs are saved.

form_fields.label: Max Log Retention (Days)
form_fields.hint: Max days to retain log files (0 disables automatic deletion).

form_fields.label: Enable In-Memory Stats Only
form_fields.hint: Enables in-memory statistics only; Last Hour stats displayed on dashboard and none written to disk.

form_fields.label: Max Stats Retention (Days)
form_fields.hint: Max days to retain dashboard stats files (0 disables automatic deletion).

form_fields.label: Enable SSO (OpenID Connect)
form_fields.hint: Enable Single Sign-On with OpenID Connect (OIDC).

form_fields.label: SSO OIDC Authority URL
form_fields.hint: The OpenID Connect Authority (Issuer) URL.

form_fields.label: SSO Client ID
form_fields.hint: The OpenID Connect Client ID.

form_fields.label: SSO Client Secret
form_fields.hint: The OpenID Connect Client Secret.

form_fields.label: SSO Client Secret File Path
form_fields.hint: Path to a file containing plain text OIDC Client Secret.

form_fields.label: SSO Metadata Discovery Address
form_fields.hint: Custom OIDC metadata discovery endpoint URL (if different from authority default).

form_fields.label: SSO Scopes
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated list of OIDC Scopes (e.g. openid,profile,email).

form_fields.label: SSO Allow User Sign Up
form_fields.hint: Automatically provision user accounts for new users signing in via SSO.

form_fields.label: SSO Allow Sign Up Only For Mapped Users
form_fields.hint: Allow new SSO users to register only if they belong to a mapped group.

form_fields.label: SSO Group Mapping
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated key:value pairs (e.g. Admins:Administrators,DNS Admins:DNS Administrators).

form_fields.label: Enable LDAP Authentication
form_fields.hint: Allow users from LDAP or Active Directory to log in.

form_fields.label: LDAP Server Hostname / IP
form_fields.hint: Domain name or IP address of the LDAP directory server.

form_fields.label: LDAP Server Port
form_fields.hint: Port number for LDAP (default 389 for plain/StartTLS, 636 for LDAPS).

form_fields.label: LDAP SSL Option
form_fields.hint: Encryption option for LDAP connection.

form_fields.label: LDAP Ignore SSL Certificate Errors
form_fields.hint: Ignore invalid or self-signed certificates on LDAP server (use for testing only).

form_fields.label: LDAP Bind Username (DN/UPN)
form_fields.hint: Distinguished Name or UPN of service account to search directory (leave empty for anonymous).

form_fields.label: LDAP Bind Password
form_fields.hint: Password for the LDAP bind service account.

form_fields.label: LDAP Bind Password File Path
form_fields.hint: Path to file containing the bind password.

form_fields.label: LDAP Search Base (DN)
form_fields.hint: Base Distinguished Name used to search for user entries (e.g. dc=example,dc=com).

form_fields.label: LDAP User Search Filter
form_fields.hint: Filter to find user. Default (sAMAccountName={0}) for Active Directory, (uid={0}) for OpenLDAP.

form_fields.label: LDAP Group Attribute
form_fields.hint: Attribute listing group memberships. Default memberOf for Active Directory.

form_fields.label: LDAP Allow User Sign Up
form_fields.hint: Automatically provision user accounts for new users signing in via LDAP.

form_fields.label: LDAP Allow Sign Up Only For Mapped Users
form_fields.hint: Set to true to restrict new LDAP user registrations to mapped groups only.

form_fields.label: LDAP Group Mapping
form_fields.hint: Comma-separated key:value pairs (e.g. Administrators:Administrators,DNS Admins:DNS Administrators).
